evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' official Solent Freeport tax-site page states that the Navigator Quarter tax site has been designated with effect from 14 October 2022. The Designation of Freeport Tax Sites (Solent Freeport) (No. 2) Regulations 2022 (SI 2022/973) designate as a special area the area shown edged and hatched in red on the map entitled 'Navigator Quarter Tax Site' dated 8 June 2022, and provide that the designation takes effect on 14 October 2022. The official map is titled 'Navigator Quarter Tax Site' and dated 08.06.2022.
